reasoning: Multiple independent polls consistently show Tisza leading Fidesz by 8-12 percentage points among decided voters (Tisza 47-50% vs Fidesz 38-39% as of late February 2026). The electoral system favors larger parties, and Tisza needs only a 3-5 point national lead to secure a majority due to boundary changes. Pro-government polls show different results, but independent pollsters are considered more reliable. With ~20% undecided voters and the election 5+ weeks away, some movement is possible, but Tisza's consistent double-digit lead is substantial. Orbán has governed since 2010 and never lost, creating uncertainty, but current polling strongly favors Tisza winning the most seats.
